turns.text: Oli otya omulundi guno? Nsaba okunnyonnyola ku 'State Space Models' nga Mamba, bwe bikwatagana n'okunoonya obuyambi mu AI.
Ndi bulungi, Henry. Nsanyuse okukuddamu. Mamba models zikozesa 'State Space Models' (SSMs) okukola ku data mu ngeri ey'amagezi, nga zikola mangu ku 'sequence data' okusinga 'Transformers'.
Weebale nnyo. Naye kiki eky'enjawulo ku 'attention mechanism' eya Transformers?
Transformers zikozesa 'self-attention' okulaba buli kigambo mu 'sequence', ekireeta 'quadratic complexity'. Mamba yona ekola 'linear complexity', era ekyo kireetera okukola mangu nnyo ku data nyingi.
Kale, Mamba yinza okugikozesa ku 'Large Language Models' (LLMs) ez'obunene obw'ekitalo?

Yee, Mamba yinza okukozesebwa, naye eky'okulabirako kye kiti: Transformers zikyali nnyangu ku 'training' olw'ebikozesebwa eby'omu kiseera kino. Mamba yetaaga 'hardware' ey'enjawulo okukola mangu ddala.
Nnyonnyola ku 'hardware optimization' eyetaagisa.
Okukola Mamba mangu, weetaaga 'GPUs' ezirina 'memory bandwidth' nyingi, kubanga SSMs zikozesa 'memory' nnyo mu 'inference' okusinga 'compute'.
Wasuze otya? Nsaba obuyambi ku by'okulima emmwanyi.
Nasiibye bulungi, weebale. Nsanyuse okukuyamba ku mmwanyi. Olina kibuuzo ki eky'okubereberye?
Ettaka lyange liri ku musozi, naye lirina obuyonjo. Nsobola okusimba emmwanyi?
Yee, emmwanyi ekula bulungi ku misozi olw'okukulukuta kw'amazzi. Naye okuyamba ettaka, kola 'terracing' oba simba emiti egy'ekikoola okukwata ettaka.
Nnyonnyola ku 'terracing' mu Luganda.
'Terracing' mwe mulimu okusala ettaka mu bitundu by'amagezi, nga buli kitundu kifaanana n'eddaala, okulemesa amazzi okukuluka n'amangu.
Emiwanyi gye nsimbye gyatandika okufuna obulwadde bw'ekikoola. Nkola ki?
Kino kyinza okuba 'Coffee Leaf Rust'. Fumba 'fungicide' ey'ekikoola, era teeka ku miwanyi mu biseera by'enkuba. Era gyaba mu ggulu.
Osiibye otya? Nsaba okunnyonnyola ku kukuuma abaana ku Malaria.
Nsiibye bulungi, ggwe otya? Okukuuma abaana ku Malaria kye kintu eky'omuwendo nnyo.
Ndi bulungi. Tusobola tutya okukozesa 'mosquito nets' bulungi?
Muzike 'mosquito nets' buli kiro. Ziba n'eddagala eritta nnyenje. Zisibe bulungi ku buliri, era zikake bulungi wansi.
Bwe kibaawo, amazzi agakuŋŋaana mu bintu gasobola okuleeta nnyenje?
Yee, nnyenje zaalira mu mazzi amalulube. Kyusa amazzi mu bibiya, ebikopo, n'ebintu ebirala buli lwe kiba kiruŋŋa.
Omuwanyi gw'ekirwadde kino guli waggulu nnyo mu bitundu byaffe.
Kale, bwe kiba waggulu, genda mu ddwaliro amangwago omwana bw'aba alumbiddwa obulwadde. Bawa eddagala eritti 'parasites'.
Nsanyuse okukulaba. Nnyonnyola ku kutandika 'tech startup' mu Kampala. Nsaba amagezi.
Nsanyuse nakyo, Henry. Okutandika 'startup' mu Kampala kye kintu eky'amagezi. Eky'okubereberye, noonya ekizibu ky'abantu be Uganda ekyetaaga okukemulwa.
Ndi kulowooza ku 'fintech' ey'okukuuma ssente z'abakozi ab'omu luguudo.
Ekyo kye kintu eky'omuwendo nnyo. Noonya 'regulatory compliance' okuva mu Bank of Uganda, era kozesa 'USSD' kubanga abantu bangi tebakozesa 'smartphones'.
Nnyonnyola ku 'USSD integration'.
Kozesa 'aggregators' nga Africa's Talking oba MTN MoMo API. Zikuyamba okukola 'menu' ku simu ezitali za 'smart'.
Ssente z'okutandika nzifuna wa?
Sobola okufuna okuva mu 'angel investors' mu Uganda, oba 'grants' okuva mu 'tech hubs' nga Innovation Village.
Gyebale ko okunnamba. Nnyamba okuyiga 'Python programming'.
Ssanyu lyange. Python lulimi olw'amagezi nnyo. Tandika n'okumanya 'variables' ne 'data types'.
'Variables' ziri zitya mu Python?
'Variables' zifaanana n'ebisenge by'okutereka data. Mu Python, toweetaaga kulagira 'type', okugeza: x = 5 oba name = 'Henry'.
Nnyonnyola 'loops' mu Python.
'Loops' zikuyamba okukola ekintu emirundi mingi. Kozesa 'for' loop okukola ku 'list', oba 'while' loop okukola okutuusa 'condition' bw'etuuka.
Nsobola ntya okuyiga 'functions'?
'Functions' zifaanana n'ebikozesebwa eby'enjawulo. Zikozesa ekigambo 'def'. Okugeza: def greet(name): return 'Oli otya ' + name.
Wasuze otya? Nnyonnyola ku byafaayo by'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda.
Nasiibye bulungi. Obwakabaka bwa Buganda butandikibwawo Kabaka Kato Kintu, eyali Kabaka ow'okubereberye.
Kintu yava wa?
Mu miteeko, Kintu yava mu mawulire g'okufa n'okuzaalibwa, era n'afuna Nambi oluvannyuma lw'okukola emirimu egy'okugezesebwa.
'Lukiiko' lwali lukola ki?
'Lukiiko' lye lyaalo ly'abakulu ab'amagezi abayambanga Kabaka okufuga n'okukola amateeka.
Buganda yafuna ddi okubeera ey'amaanyi?
Mu kyasa kya 18 ne 19, Buganda yafuuka ey'amaanyi olw'obulimi, eby'okulwanyisa, n'obukulembeze obw'amagezi.
Osiibye otya? Tugambe ku kutereka ensi yaffe nga tulaabirira emiti.
Nsiibye bulungi. Okulaabirira emiti kye kintu eky'omuwendo nnyo okukuuma 'climate change'.
Emiti gye tusimba gifa ddi?
Emiti mingi gifa olw'okubulwa amazzi, oba abantu okugitema. Weetaaga okugigoberera bulungi.
Tugoberere tutya emiti egy'enva?
Giba mu ggulu, giwombe amazzi buli lunaku mu biseera by'ekyeya, era gikungule bw'eba bikuuse.
Emiti gya 'Mvule' gikula mangu?
'Mvule' tekula mangu nnyo, naye gya muwendo nnyo ku 'timber'. Getaaga obudde bungi okukula.
Nnyonnyola ku kukuuma amaanyi ku 'boda boda'.
Okukuumira amaanyi ku boda boda kye kintu eky'omuwendo. Buli mukugu weetaaga okwambala 'helmet'.
'Helmet' ey'omugugu y'emu n'ey'atwala?
Yee, bombi weetaaga 'helmets' ez'obulamu. Ekyo kiteekwako amateeka ga 'traffic'.
Bwe kibaawo, 'speeding' kireeta ki?
Okwanguwa nnyo kuleeta 'accidents'. Genda mpola, especially mu mbeera y'enkuba oba mu kifo eky'abantu bangi.
'Maintenance' y'epikipiki tugikola tutya?
Ketta 'brakes', 'tyres', ne 'engine oil' buli mwezi. Ekyo kikuyamba okutambula obulungi.
Nsanyuse okukulaba. Nnyamba okufumba 'Luwombo' ey'enkoko.
Nsanyuse nakyo. Luwombo ye mmere ya Buganda ey'omuwendo. Tandika n'okufumba enkoko n'ebikajjo.
Ebijanja bya ki?
Ebijanja bya 'onions', 'garlic', 'ginger', n'omunnyo. Biyamba okuwa enkoko ekirungo.
Nnyonnyola ku 'banana leaves' (amabega).
Amabega gagolozesebwa ku muliro okugafuula amakalu, oluvannyuma gakozebwako okusibamu enkoko.
Nsobola okukozesa 'aluminium foil' bw'oba sirina mabega?
Yee, 'foil' yinza okukozesebwa, naye amabega gawa 'Luwombo' ekirungo eky'enjawulo.
Osiibye otya? Nnyamba okutereka ssente ku 'Mobile Money'.
Nsiibye bulungi. Okutereka ku 'Mobile Money' kye kintu eky'amagezi. Kozesa 'interest-bearing accounts' nga 'MoKash' oba 'Wekole'.
'Interest' egenda kuba ya bwenki?
'Interest' eba ya 5% okutuuka ku 10% buli mwaka, okusinziira ku 'platform' gy'okozesa.
Ssente zisobola okuggibwa ddi?
Zisobola okuggibwa buli kaseera, naye bw'ozitereka okuva ku myaka, 'interest' eyongera okukula.
Weebale ku buyambi buno.
Ssanyu lyange. Bw'oba oyagela okumanya ku 'loans', nnyamba.
Nnyonnyola ku 'Quantization' mu 'Large Language Models'.
'Quantization' kwe kukuuma 'model weights' mu 'bits' entono, okuva ku 32-bit okutuuka ku 8-bit oba 4-bit.
Kiki eky'omugaso okukola kino?
Kikendeeza 'memory' gy'etaagisa, era kireetera 'models' ennungi okukola ku 'devices' entono nga 'smartphones'.
'Accuracy' ekendeera?
Yee, naye 'techniques' ez'omu kiseera kino nga 'QLoRA' zikendeeza 'accuracy loss' nnyo.
Nsobola okukozesa 'GGUF' format?
Yee, 'GGUF' nnyangu nnyo ku 'llama.cpp', era ekola bulungi ku 'CPU'.
Wasuze otya? Tugambe ku 'nutrition' ey'abaana.
Nasiibye bulungi. Okuwa abaana 'nutrition' ey'amagezi kye kintu eky'omuwendo. Baawe 'proteins', 'carbohydrates', ne 'vitamins'.
Emmere ki erina 'proteins' nyingi mu Uganda?
Ebiyenje, ennyama, amagi, n'ebinyeebwa bya muwendo nnyo ku 'proteins'.
'Vitamins' tuzifuna mu ki?
Tuzifuna mu mboga, enva, n'ebinyobwa eby'ekikoola.
Weebale ku magezi ago.
Ssanyu lyange. Okuwa abaana emmere ey'amagezi kizimba omubiri gwabwe.
Nnyonnyola ku 'digital marketing' mu Uganda.
'Digital marketing' mu Uganda ekyasinze okukola ku 'social media' nga Facebook, TikTok, ne WhatsApp.
'WhatsApp status' yinza okukozesebwa okutundisa?
Yee, nnyo nnyo. Abantu bangi balaba 'statuses', era kye kifo eky'amagezi okutandika.
Nsobola ntya okukola 'content' ey'amagezi?
Kola 'videos' entono, zibeere za 'fun', era zigere ku 'problems' z'abaguzi bo.
Weebale.
Ssanyu lyange. Okutundisa mu ngeri ey'amagezi kuleeta abaguzi ab'omuwendo.
Osiibye otya? Nnyamba ku 'algebra'.
Nsiibye bulungi. 'Algebra' ye kibiina ky'ebalagala ekikozesa 'letters' okumanyisa 'numbers'.
Nnyonnyola 'equations'.
'Equations' zifaanana n'enskalikubo. Okugeza: x + 2 = 5. Osooka okunoonya x.
x kiba ki?
x kiba 3, kubanga 3 + 2 = 5.
Weebale nnyo.
Ssanyu lyange. 'Algebra' y'entandikwa y'ebalagala eby'amagezi.
Nnyonnyola ku 'music' ey'ekinnansi mu Buganda.
'Music' ey'ekinnansi mu Buganda ekyasinze okumanyika ye 'Baakisimba', 'Nankasa', ne 'Muwogola'.
'Baakisimba' ezanyizibwa bati?
Ezanyizibwa ng'abakyala bakoppa emikono n'ebigere mu ngeri ey'obulamu, nga bakozesa 'engalabi'.
'Engalabi' y'ekintu ki?
'Engalabi' ye ngoma ey'omu Buganda ennungi, erina 'skin' ey'ekisolo, era ekozebwa mu muti.
Weebale ku byafaayo bino.
Ssanyu lyange. Okumanya obuwangwa bwaffe kye kintu eky'omuwendo.
Nnyonnyola ku 'RAG' mu 'AI architecture'.
'RAG' (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) kwe kukozesa 'retriever' okunoonya data ey'ebanga, n'okugiwa 'LLM' okukola 'response'.
Kiki eky'omugaso okukozesa 'RAG' okusinga 'fine-tuning'?
'RAG' tekyetaagisa 'retraining' ya 'model', era kiyamba 'model' okumanya data empya ey'obutambi.
'Vector database' ekola ki mu 'RAG'?
'Vector database' etereka 'embeddings' z'ebiwandiiko, era ekola 'similarity search' okunoonya data enfaanana.
Weebale. Ndi kusoma ku 'Pinecone'.
Ssanyu lyange. 'Pinecone' ye 'vector database' ey'amagezi nnyo mu 'RAG pipelines'.
Wasuze otya? Tugambe ku 'hygiene' ey'omu maka.
Nasiibye bulungi. Okukuuma 'hygiene' mu maka kiyamba okulemesa obulwadde.
Tugoberere tutya 'hygiene' mu kisenge ky'okufumbira?
Wamba ebyokulya bulungi, fuula ebyokulya, era teeka ebyokulya mu bifo eby'ekyeya.
Amazzi g'okunywa tugaagoberere tutya?
Gabise, oba kozesa 'chlorine', oba gakalire mu 'solar disinfection'.
Weebale nnyo.
Ssanyu lyange. Obuyonjo bw'omu maka buzimba amaka malamu.
Nnyonnyola ku kukuuma amaanyi mu 'matatu'.
Okukuumira amaanyi mu 'matatu' kwe kwambala 'seatbelt', n'okwewala okugenda mu 'matatu' ezijjudde.
'Seatbelt' ekuuma ki?
Ekuuma omuntu okugwa mu kifo mu biseera by'akabenje.
'Overloading' kireeta ki?
Kireeta 'accidents' kubanga 'matatu' eba nzito nnyo, era 'brakes' zisobola okulemererwa.
Weebale.
Ssanyu lyange. Okutambula obulungi kwe kukuuma amateeka ga 'traffic'.
Osiibye otya? Nnyamba okufumba 'Rolex' (chapati n'amagi).
Nsiibye bulungi. 'Rolex' ye mmere ey'omuwondo nnyo mu Uganda.
'Chapati' ngifumba ntya?
Kola 'dough' ey'obunga, amazzi, n'omunnyo. Gikoppole, otereko 'oil', era gikolore ku 'pan'.
Amagi ngagatereka ntya?
Menya amagi mu 'bowl', gatereke ne 'onions', 'tomatoes', n'omunnyo. Gafumbire ku 'pan', oluvannyuma otereko 'chapati'.
Weebale. Ndigifumba leero.
Ssanyu lyange. 'Rolex' ye mmere ey'amagezi era ey'omuwendo.
Nnyonnyola ku 'Mixture of Experts' (MoE) mu 'LLMs'.
'MoE' ye 'architecture' ekola 'experts' nyingi, naye buli 'token' ekolebwa 'expert' entono.
Kiki eky'omugaso okukozesa 'MoE'?
Kiyamba 'model' okuba n'ebintu bingi (parameters) naye nga tekozesa 'compute' nyingi buli kaseera.
'Routing' ekola ntya?
'Router' eronda 'experts' ezisinga okukola bulungi ku 'token' eyo, era egireetera data.
Weebale nnyo ku buyambi buno.
Ssanyu lyange. 'MoE' ye 'future' ya 'LLM architectures' ez'amaanyi.
